properties_location_range.name: properties_location_range
properties_location_range.value: ("properties"."latitude" IS NULL AND "properties"."longitude" IS NULL) OR ("properties"."latitude" IS NOT NULL AND "properties"."longitude" IS NOT NULL AND "properties"."latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "properties"."longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180)

rentals_location_range.name: rentals_location_range
rentals_location_range.value: ("rentals"."latitude" IS NULL AND "rentals"."longitude" IS NULL) OR ("rentals"."latitude" IS NOT NULL AND "rentals"."longitude" IS NOT NULL AND "rentals"."latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "rentals"."longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180)

studio_contract_asset_domain.name: studio_contract_asset_domain
studio_contract_asset_domain.value: ("studio_contracts"."contract_type"='sale' AND "studio_contracts"."rental_id" IS NULL) OR ("studio_contracts"."contract_type"='rental' AND "studio_contracts"."property_id" IS NULL)

studio_contract_distinct_parties.name: studio_contract_distinct_parties
studio_contract_distinct_parties.value: "studio_contracts"."first_person_id" IS NULL OR "studio_contracts"."second_person_id" IS NULL OR "studio_contracts"."first_person_id"<>"studio_contracts"."second_person_id"

studio_contract_dates.name: studio_contract_dates
studio_contract_dates.value: "studio_contracts"."start_date" IS NULL OR "studio_contracts"."end_date" IS NULL OR "studio_contracts"."end_date">="studio_contracts"."start_date"

studio_template_payload.name: studio_template_payload
studio_template_payload.value: ("studio_templates"."template_kind"='content' AND "studio_templates"."content_json" IS NOT NULL AND "studio_templates"."design_config" IS NULL) OR ("studio_templates"."template_kind"='design' AND "studio_templates"."design_config" IS NOT NULL AND "studio_templates"."content_json" IS NULL)
